Kidney & Bladder Health

Ailment kidney bladder urinary fluid-balance detox

Evidence: scientific

Summary

Comprehensive kidney and bladder health covering urinary tract infections, bladder dysfunction, kidney stones, and related conditions affecting fluid balance and toxin removal.

Symptoms

  • urinary urgency
  • bladder discomfort
  • kidney pain
  • frequent urination
  • urinary urgency at night
  • difficulty starting urination
  • weak urine stream
  • hematuria (blood in urine)
  • flank pain

Remedies for This Condition

  • Cell Salts
    Biochemical tissue salts (Schuessler salts) that help regulate fluid balance and cellular function in the body.
  • Celery Seed
    Natural diuretic that helps reduce fluid retention and uric acid buildup, beneficial for edema and gout.
  • Herbal Adjustment Formula
    Proprietary blend of herbs designed to support lymphatic drainage and fluid balance.
  • Hydrangea Root
    Traditional herb used to support kidney and bladder function, helpful for fluid retention.
  • Parsley
    Natural diuretic rich in potassium and vitamins that reduces fluid retention while maintaining electrolyte balance.
  • Juniper Berry
    Natural antiseptic and diuretic that supports urinary tract health and helps flush infections, particularly UTIs and kidney issues.
  • Dandelion Root
    Powerful liver and kidney tonic that acts as a natural diuretic without depleting potassium, helping with fluid retention and urinary system health.
  • Corn Silk
    Gentle diuretic and kidney tonic that specifically supports urinary tract health, reducing inflammation and promoting urine flow.
  • Goldenrod
    Anti-inflammatory herb that supports urinary tract and kidney function, helpful for UTIs and kidney stone prevention.
  • Vitamin D
    Fat-soluble vitamin essential for bone health, immune modulation, and mood regulation.

Affected Body Systems

  • renal
  • urinary
  • circulatory
  • lymphatic

Severity Levels

  • mild
  • moderate
  • severe

Related Conditions

  • Bladder Issues
    Bladder dysfunction including urinary retention, urgency, and discomfort, often linked to fluid imbalance and tissue salt deficiencies.
  • Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)
    Infection anywhere in the urinary tract, most commonly in women. Characterized by burning pain during urination and frequent urges.
  • Urinary Retention
    Difficulty emptying the bladder completely, leading to urinary urgency and potential bladder dysfunction.
  • Diuretic Herbs & Bladder Tonics
    Collection of herbal formulas specifically designed to support bladder function and promote healthy urinary elimination.
  • Prostatitis
    Inflammation of the prostate gland, often causing pain and urinary symptoms.
